project.name: archlearn
project.description: A living architecture document for AI-built projects.

services.name: CLI
services.description: Package entrypoint for init, serve, status, export, and learn commands.

services.name: MCP Server
services.description: MCP server exposing architecture tools and resources over stdio/HTTP

services.name: Viewer
services.description: Interactive web viewer with 6 views: topology, data flow, decisions, components, stack, learning mode

services.name: Scanner
services.description: Static analysis scanner that reads package.json and source imports to detect drift

services.name: Learning Mode
services.description: Learning mode with Socratic quizzing and progress tracking

connections.description: CLI reads and renders templates during project initialization.
CLI uses schema validation when creating and updating architecture.json.
CLI starts MCP server via serve command
CLI invokes scanner for reconcile and status commands
Viewer fetches architecture data from MCP server
MCP server validates architecture changes via Zod schema

decisions.decision: Bundle the CLI in dist/ and publish templates and agent instructions alongside it.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the installed package self-contained for init and agent setup.

alternatives.name: Ship only source files
alternatives.whyNot: Would require a build step after install and make the package harder to use.

decisions.decision: Bundle MCP server and web viewer in a single npm package
decisions.rationale: Users want one install command, not two packages to coordinate

alternatives.name: Separate @archlearn/server and @archlearn/viewer packages
alternatives.whyNot: Adds coordination complexity and goes against user's stated preference for unified tooling

decisions.decision: Force React 19 via Vite aliases to deduplicate with root project
decisions.rationale: Viewer nested in src/viewer/ caused React 18 vs 19 duplicate, breaking hooks. Vite alias + dedupe resolves it.

alternatives.name: Pin viewer to React 18 independently
alternatives.whyNot: Would still cause duplicate React instances since root has React 19

decisions.decision: Support both stdio (--stdio flag) and HTTP modes in serve command
decisions.rationale: stdio is required for Claude Code plugin integration; HTTP is needed for the web viewer

alternatives.name: stdio only
alternatives.whyNot: Would prevent serving the web viewer

alternatives.name: HTTP only
alternatives.whyNot: Claude Code plugins require stdio transport

steps.action: Renders templates and writes project files
Calls update_architecture MCP tool with changes

history.summary: Added remove semantics to MCP update_architecture tool
